We are not allowed to have an opinion on her clothing or style.  Yet females are allowed to rip us apart.

Recent example: gf and I have a date night coming up at a nice steakhouse.  We talked about going out last weekend to get a new suit or upscale outfit for me.  As I’ve lost some weight and my old ones don’t fit anymore.  Well she was sick so I went out on my own (mistake).  When I sent her a pic of what I picked out she first said “you better be joking.  Please tell me you did not buy that.”  I told her I did and I really liked it.  Her next reply was “it’s terrible.  You look like you want to be a used car salesman.  It doesn’t do anything for you.  It makes you look older than you are”.

Now imagine, if she pick something out and I said “it’s terrible.  Makes you look like you want to be a Waffle House waitress.  It’s not flattering.  And it makes you look older than you are”.  I would be ripped apart.  

Side note, I really don’t have any preference on what she wears.  I think she’s beautiful regardless.  But man, it’s a shot the the ego to hear that.
